summary: Register the accepted Fe(110) CO-dissociation Dimer TS, compatible SIGMA=0.20 electronic barrier, Topic-1 workbook row, and reusable strategy template.

payload.objective: Preserve the accepted Fe(110) CO-dissociation Dimer TS and its compatible formal electronic barrier for reporting and strategy reuse.
current_evidence: Dimer job `9656664` is accepted from hard force convergence, negative curvature, reviewed Force/Torque residuals, and one accepted target imaginary mode at `537.451689 cm^-1`.
The hash-bound IS, TS, and FS outputs use the same PBE/PAW-PBE, ENCUT, k-point, magnetic, smearing, SIGMA=0.20, slab, atom-order, and constraint conventions.
Using final OUTCAR TOTEN under `fe110_converged_toten_sigma0p20_v1`, the forward electronic barrier is `1.350209 eV`, the reverse barrier is `2.056573 eV`, and the reaction energy is `-0.706364 eV`.
The TS validation, barrier set, Topic-1 Excel row, and reusable strategy template are registered; no new VASP job was submitted.
payload.one_executable_step: Use the registered barrier and exact-fingerprint strategy template when a compatible future Fe(110) CO-dissociation task requests retrieval; calculate thermochemical corrections separately if a free-energy barrier is needed.
payload.submission_boundary: This registration authorizes no new VASP, NEB, Dimer, frequency, connectivity, or scheduler action.
done_when: The compatible SIGMA=0.20 IS/TS/FS chain is hash-bound and registered.
The formal electronic barrier is stored in the canonical registry and Topic-1 workbook.
The accepted calculation strategy is retrievable from the reusable strategy library.
